notes: Wipe automations now run their steps against the linked panel and record whether the run succeeded.
If nobody voted, the map is left unchanged and the server still stops and starts.
Next.js is updated from 16.4.0 to 16.4.3 for a published security fix.
changed: The same map can be used on more than one vote, and admins can see vote totals while a vote is still open.
The vote time picker keeps a typed hour, and a missed vote-end automation runs on the next scheduler check.
